environment.blocker: No pinned LLM judge/synthesis transport is available in this build/CI environment (automated eval tests are offline by design), so the LLM-judged accuracy / mean_score / delta_accuracy numbers cannot be produced here without re-baselining on a different judge (which the fixed-model contract forbids). Per issue #16's fallback, the deterministic, LLM-free retrieval-recall (hit@k) metric is reported instead.

retrieval_recall.corpus: one record per CVE-specific question (its committed reference answer), matched by the question text
